name: Find-My-Timeline
description: Find My Timeline is a self-hosted location-history dashboard for Apple devices available through the Find My service. It polls device locations at configurable intervals, stores the history locally in SQLite and displays routes, timestamps, battery levels and chronological timelines on an interactive map. The Unraid edition includes persistent appdata storage, Docker health monitoring and optional protected Apple re-authentication. This is an unofficial project and the WebUI must not be exposed directly to the internet.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database containing device and location history. Include this directory in protected backups.

paths.name: Apple Session
paths.description: Stores reusable Apple session cookies and authentication metadata. Keep this mapping enabled during updates and include it in protected backups.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Host port used to open the responsive Find My Timeline WebUI. Keep this port limited to your trusted network and do not expose it directly to the internet.

variables.name: Apple ID
variables.description: Email address of the Apple ID whose Find My devices should be recorded. Do not enter the Apple password in this field.

variables.name: Enable WebUI authentication flow
variables.description: Set to true to allow Apple re-authentication from the WebUI. Requires a WebUI administrator password and protected network access.

variables.name: WebUI administrator password
variables.description: Create a long and unique password for starting Apple authentication from the WebUI. This protects only authentication actions, not the location map or APIs.

variables.name: Estimated session lifetime
variables.description: Estimated Apple session lifetime in days used by the status countdown. Apple can invalidate a session earlier.

variables.name: Authentication flow timeout
variables.description: Maximum number of seconds allowed between starting Apple authentication and entering the verification code.

variables.name: Apple ID password
variables.description: Optional persistent Apple password. Leaving this empty reduces stored secrets and is recommended for most installations.

variables.name: Minimum polling interval
variables.description: Minimum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Use a value no greater than the maximum interval.

variables.name: Maximum polling interval
variables.description: Maximum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Must be equal to or greater than the minimum interval.

variables.name: Database path
variables.description: Database file path inside the container. Change only when using a custom persistent data layout.

variables.name: Web host
variables.description: Internal web server binding. Keep 0.0.0.0 when using the standard Unraid bridge network.

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: Internal container port for the WebUI. Normally this should remain 5000.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for container logs and displayed timestamps, for example Europe/Berlin.
